hypothesis: Test whether Flash can preserve explicit nonempty target cells over long removal plans, including isolated target cells, alongside the familiar clearing objective.
comparison: 100 distinct fresh initial boards under original eight shapes, twelve construction placements and the existing text/JSON contract. Exclude translation-equivalent roots in previous Flash suites. Fifty clear tasks have the original unfiltered clearing distribution. Fifty reachable nonempty tasks have exact shortest distance9--13:25 have an orthogonally isolated occupied goal cell (five per exact distance),25 have no isolated cell and every goal cell belongs to a legal goal-board shape. Normal retained goals are accepted anywhere in9--13, with actual distance counts reported. Descendants come from the optimal clearing certificate and random legal removal paths; selection uses only task properties, never model scores. Goal types and distance distributions are not matched causal comparisons. The model receives only initial/goal boards, shared rules and output instructions, without distances, certificates or candidate lists. One valid response per case; only service failures retry; wrong answers, truncation and over-budget answers are retained. Independently replay every plan against the exact goal, and diagnose any removal of a required target cell. No Q model, training or agent-side tools.
